visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hands are shown holding a large silver fish over a stainless steel sink. They use a metal scaler to scrape off the scales, which fly around. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Cut to a medium shot in a commercial kitchen with two men. One man in a denim jacket stands behind another in a white apron, pointing and talking while the other handles the fish under a running tap. (3) The camera returns to a close-up of the fish. Pink scissors are used to pierce the belly of the fish and cut it open along the ventral side. (4) Hands continue using the scissors to pull out the internal organs. A darker filter is briefly applied to the footage to obscure the bloody details. The sink and metal colander are visible. (5) The scissors are inserted into the gill area, twisting and pulling the red gills out. These are dropped into a colander with other waste. The scene ends with a shot of the cleaned fish in the sink.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic background music starts. A male voice speaks enthusiastically about a cooking lesson. (2) A sharp scraping sound occurs as the fish is scaled. Background chatter includes excited reactions and laughing. (3) Sound of running tap water creates a continuous broadband floor. A second male voice provides clear, helpful instructions on kitchen tips. (4) Distinct metallic snipping sounds of scissors are heard. Voices express mock disgust and humor regarding the smell and appearance of the fish organs. (5) Wet squelching sounds of organs being removed are prominent. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (6) A final splash of water and a celebratory vocal exclamation conclude the segment. BGM cuts out abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers while providing a semi-educational, humorous look at the process of cleaning a fish, branded as an 'unprofessional' cooking class.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high density of variety-show style subtitles and sound effects to maintain a fast, engaging pace. The contrast between the 'unprofessional' title and the actual cleaning process creates comedic effect.
